name: Airbag Malfunction
description: This is the air bag malfunction light. This could either say Air Bag, SRS, or a person with a deployed airbag. This light can come in a variety of shapes depending on which air bag is malfunctioning.
fixDescr: If this light is on, a professional mechanic should be contacted. If the air bags don't function as they should, they may not work in the case of an emergency.

name: Auto Start-Stop Warning
description: Depending on the color of the light and the vehicle, this light could mean whether the Auto Start-Stop system is functioning or not. Should consult with your owners manual to determine more specifically what this light determines.
fixDescr: Refer your vehicle's owners manual for more information about what to do, and when in doubt, consult with a professional mechanic.

name: Automatic Emergency Brake Light
description: The Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB) system warning light. The light usually turns on when the AEB system is set to OFF on the meter display. If the light illuminates when the AEB system is on, it may indicate that the AEB system is unavailable at the time. If there is the word OFF underneath the image it may indicate that the warning is the Pre-Collision System Light, which means that the vehicle is not working as it should. That light is to prevent or minimize the risk of injury if an accident is to occur.
fixDescr: If the AEB Light is on, refer to the vehicle's owners manual, or contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible. While it is safe to drive with this light on, if there is a problem with the brakes, the vehicle should not be driven.

name: Battery:Charging Light
description: Anything to do with this light has something to do with the battery. Normally this light indicates that the voltage level of the battery is below the normal level. When the battery is not working fully, it can lead to the headlights failing and even shutting down the engine. The problem could be with the battery itself, the wiring, or more seriously, the alternator or drive belt.
fixDescr: For this light it is best to contact a mechanic as soon as possible. You can drive with this light on, but it is important to get it checked out as soon as possible.

name: Brake Fluid Light
description: This light indicates that the brake fluid level is below the normal level. It is important to have the recommended level of brake fluid in the vehicle to allow the brakes to function at their appropriate level.
fixDescr: Add brake fluid to the recommended level, and if the light is still on contact a licensed mechanic.

name: Brake Pad Warning Light
description: The Brake Pad Warning Light. This indicates that the brake pads, one of the more important parts of the brakes, are wearing low and might require replacement soon. If the light persists when the pads have been replaced it could be a sensor issue.
fixDescr: You should get the brake pads replaced as soon a possible. This light comes on before the pads are completely worn, to give time to replace. Consult your vehicle's manual to determine how long until you will need to replace the pads after the light comes on.

name: Brake System Warning Light
description: The Brake System Warning Light. Some vehicles have a separate warning light for the parking brake that has a P instead of !. This warning light can mean many different things about the brakes. It can be as simple as leaving the hand brake on while driving away, the brake fluid needs topping off, or the brake pad wear sensor is not working. If the brakes go all the way to the floor, it could indicate that the car should not be driven any further.
fixDescr: To fix, it depends on what is the cause of the light. It could be as simple as putting the hand brake down or putting brake fluid, but in some serious causes you should contact a mechanic as soon as possible.

name: Catalytic Converter Warning
description: This is the Catalytic Converter Overheat sensor warning light. The catalytic converter is an important part of any vehicles engine, so if it is failing, it can lead to reduced engine power and performance. The light could also mean that the component and the engine could be experiencing higher than normal temperatures.
fixDescr: Visit a professional mechanic as soon as possible. You can drive if the light just came on, but the faster you get to a mechanic, the better the odds.

name: Distance Warning
description: The distance warning light will come on when a vehicle, or object, is too close to the vehicle in front of it.
fixDescr: The light should go out when you slow down or pass the obstruction.

name: Door Ajar
description: This light will come on when one or more of the doors are open or not closed properly.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, pull over, if possible, and make sure all of the doors are closed. Some vehicles have a separate light for when the trunk is open, so check if that is closed properly too. It is safe to drive with the light on, but make sure to pull over and check all the doors.

name: Engine Temperature Warning Light
description: The Engine Temperature warning light could be a thermometer or show the words 'temp' or 'engine overheating'. The temperature of an engine can get very high, so the engine uses coolant to keep the temperature at a reasonable level. If this light comes on, that means that the temperature of the vehicle is operating at a dangerous level. This light will also come on if there is a blockage in the system, causing the overheating, or a low level of coolant in the engine. If this light comes on, don’t drive the vehicle until the vehicle is checked by a professional mechanic as soon as possible.
fixDescr: If you feel like you can do it, fill the coolant tank with an appropriate level of coolant. If not go to a mechanic as soon as possible, but DO NOT DRIVE THE VEHICLE if this light comes on.

name: Hazard Lights On
description: The Hazard Warning Lights are to be turned on only to warn other drivers. They are usually activated by pressing the hazard light button, located mostly near the steering wheel or the middle of the dashboard. It is important to know the highway code for your specific area before you want to use them, as the conditions where one can use their hazard lights are different from country to country.
fixDescr: To turn the hazard lights off, press the hazard light button off.

name: Key Fob Battery Low
description: Most of the key fobs run on batteries. The Key Fob Battery Light turns on when the vehicle notices that the key fob’s battery is running low or completely dead.
fixDescr: To fix this light, replace the battery in the key fob. Some owner’s manuals have ways to replace the batteries of a key fob. Be warned that if the battery gets too low the car will be unable to start.

name: Master Warning Light
description: The Master Warning Light is a secondary light that comes on along with another light or text message. It is important to know what message the other light is warning about to know what is causing the issue.
fixDescr: This is hard to figure out, since the problem is usually associated with the other light that comes on with this light. Check what the other light is, and if you are still concerned contact a professional mechanic.

name: Oil Pressure Warning Light
description: The Oil Pressure Warning Light will come on when the vehicle senses that there is not enough oil in the vehicle to function at its full capacity. Some vehicles have both yellow and red Oil Pressure Warning Lights. The owner’s manual usually has the type of oil that is needed in the vehicle. Sometimes the sticker the mechanic puts on the windshield for the next oil change also has the type of oil the vehicle could take, otherwise contact a professional mechanic.
fixDescr: When the vehicle senses that the level of oil in the car is at the appropriate level, then the light should go off.  If the light is yellow or amber, that means that the oil level is low and requires oil. If the light is red it is not recommended to be driven until the oil is topped off.

name: Parking Brake Light
description: Every vehicle is equipped with its very own hand brake. The Parking Break Light comes on when the hand break is engaged. This light is to remind someone not to drive with the hand brake engaged. If the hand brake is down and the light is still on, it could be a more serious problem, so you should contact a mechanic.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, ideally just turn the hand brake off, usually by putting it down. It is advisable to not drive with this light on, as it can cause the brakes to get worn to the point of being unusable.

name: Power Steering Warning Light
description: The Power Steering Warning Light comes on when there is a problem with the power steering system. The power steering system helps the driver to turn the steering wheel with little effort. Once the power steering system goes bad it will become increasingly harder to turn the steering wheel.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, fill the power steering fluid to the appropriate level. It is important to not ignore this light, and fill the power steering fluid as soon as the light comes on, before more serious damage happens.

name: Seat Belt Indicator
description: As per vehicle safety standards, all vehicles are equipped with a Seatbelt Warning Light. When the ignition switch is turned on, this light turns on to remind the driver and or passenger to fasten the seatbelts.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, make sure your seatbelt is securely fastened. It is illegal to drive a vehicle without a seatbelt.

name: Security Indicator
description: The Security Indicator Light comes on when the key has been removed from the engine switch, to indicate that the security system has been turned on. If the light turns on when the vehicle is on, then there could be a fault with the system and should be checked by a professional mechanic.
fixDescr: The light should turn off on its own when the key is put back into the ignition. This light is similar to the child safety lock in many vehicles, so make sure to consult the owner’s manual for further information.

name: Steering Wheel Lock
description: The Steering Wheel Lock Light comes on when the steering lock needs to be released before the vehicle can be started. If the light remains on after the vehicle is on, there may be a malfunction with the mechanism. Normally you should not see this light when the vehicle is on.
fixDescr: If this light comes on when driving, pull over and turn the engine off then on again. If the light is still on, have the vehicle checked by a professional mechanic.

name: Tire Pressure Warning Light
description: All vehicles come with a set of tires. The Tire Pressure Warning Light comes on when the air pressure in either one or more tires is low. Most gas/ fuel stations come with a  device to put air in the tires, and most vehicles have a sticker on the door that has how much air, or PSI, a tire should have.
fixDescr: The light may go out when there is enough air in the tire, then a reset procedure is completed, or the vehicle is driven a bit. If the light is still on no matter what, there may be a problem with the tire pressure sensor monitor, so a mechanic should be consulted. If the vehicle is driven with a low tire for a long distance the tire may come off the rim or be damaged beyond repair.

name: Transmission Temperature
description: The Transmission Temperature Light comes on when the vehicle’s transmission starts to operate at an unusually high temperature. Vehicles use transmission fluid to help monitor the temperature of the transmission, so if this light is on for an extended period of time, it can lead to issues with the transmission.
fixDescr: If this light is on, pull over and allow the transmission to cool down. You can put transmission fluid in the vehicle, but you should contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible, as driving with an overheating transmission can cause serious problems.

name: Check Engine Light
description: This light indicates that there is an issue with the engine. This light could mean something minor, like the gas cap not on properly, or a much larger problem. Sometimes when this light comes on the vehicle will enter a “Limp Home” mode that reduces the cars performance.
fixDescr: Whenever this light comes on, it is important to get a professional mechanic to check it out, especially if the light is blinking. It is not recommended to drive the vehicle with this light on, as the problem it could be identifying could cause damage to the vehicle.

name: Engine Start System Fault
description: The Engine Start System Fault Light will come on when there is a problem with the electronics. If the light is red, the vehicle should not be turned off, and a mechanic should be called immediately. If the color is amber or yellow, you should contact them sooner rather than later. The light is similar in appearances to some ignition switch lights, so be sure which light is on.
fixDescr: If this light is on, a mechanic should be contacted as soon as possible.

name: Powertrain Fault
description: The Powertrain Light and the Drivetrain Light share a similar warning light in many vehicles. This light is also similar to the automatic gearbox warning light. All of these parts have something to do with how the engine functions. This light can look like the Transmission Issues warning light for some vehicles, so refer to the vehicle’s owners manual for more information about this light.
fixDescr: Everything about the powertrain and the drivetrain can be difficult to repair, so contacting a mechanic is important.

name: EPC
description: The EPC light, or the Electric Power Control light, comes on when there is a problem with the throttle system in the vehicle. The light should not be confused for the ESP, Electronic Stability Program, Light.
fixDescr: If this light comes on, a professional mechanic will need to be contacted to fix the problem. Since this light can indicate a problem with the vehicle, it is not recommended to drive the vehicle with this light on.

name: Water in Fuel Warning
description: When the Water in Fuel Light comes on that means that the fuel in the vehicle could be contaminated. One of the most common things that could contaminate the fuel is water. There is usually a filter to remove water from the fuel, but if this light is on that means that water managed to make its way through the filter to the fuel. The engine should be switched off as soon as possible.
fixDescr: When this light comes on, contact a mechanic as soon as possible. It is not an emergency if the light just came on, but it is important to get the vehicle checked out as soon as possible.

name: Traction Control Malfunction
description: The Traction Control Malfunction Light comes on when the system detects a problem with the traction control system. In some vehicles, the system that controls the traction control system also controls the anti lock brakes. This light can come on with the ABS Light. This light is also called the ESP Fault light, and can look like a light with the words ‘ESP’ either alone or in a circle.
fixDescr: If this light comes on a professional mechanic should be contacted as soon as possible. Since this light has something to do with the brakes, it is not recommended to drive with this light on.

name: Air Suspension
description: The Air Suspension light comes on when the computer detects a problem with the air suspension. The air suspension allows the driver to tailor their driving experience, to a certain extent. When this light is on that means that the air suspension is in a raised setting, or there is a glitch in the system.
fixDescr: The only way to turn this light off is to use a scan tool that all professional mechanics use. If this light is on, contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible.

name: All Wheel:4 Wheel Drive
description: This light indicates that the car is in 4 wheel drive, or all wheel drive mode. 4 wheel drive is mostly used for difficult terrains, such as snow, sand and gravel.
fixDescr: 4 wheel drive should not be used on dry pavement, as it can cause strain on the vehicle. Some vehicles change between modes automatically, but if you don't have that type there is a switch that changes the modes. If the 4 wheel drive doesn't seem to be working, contact a professional mechanic.

name: Antilock Brake System Warning Light
description: This light indicates that there is a problem with the ABS (anti-lock braking system). Since the brakes are one of the most important components of a vehicle, it is important to get them checked. If the light comes on when the vehicle is in motion, the brakes will still work, but in an emergency they may not engage. If this light comes on with the brake light, it can mean that the vehicle is no longer safe to drive.
fixDescr: It is not safe to drive with this light on, because that means that the ABS, or even worse, the entire brake system, may not be working properly. When the light comes on, contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible.

name: Attention Assist Symbol
description: The Attention Assist Warning Light comes on when the vehicle detects changes in the driver’s driving that may be caused by fatigue. As cars get smarter, the more they will try and keep drivers safe, so when this light comes on it is recommended to take a brake.
fixDescr: If this light is on, take a brake or switch drivers. While it is fine to drive with this light on, whether the driver is able to drive is something that should be considered before going any further.

name: Auto High Beam
description: Vehicles are getting smarter and smarter, and are now able to know when another vehicle is close. When this light is on it means that the high beam is illuminated on the vehicle and will switch between the low and high beam depending on when the sensor detects an oncoming vehicle.
fixDescr: This light has no cause for concern. As with normal high beam lights the light should turn off when the high beams are turned off.

name: Brake Hold Indicator
description: This is the Brake Hold Light. This advisory light means that the brake hold feature is enabled. This feature allows the vehicle to remain still while your foot is off the brake pedal and the vehicle is in drive. This light should only be on when the vehicle is not in motion
fixDescr: This light should go away when the gas pedal is pressed. If the light remains on even while driving contact a professional mechanic.

name: Car on Ramp
description: This image is the Car on a Ramp/Jack. Depending on the vehicle and color of the light this light could be a simple advisory, or a serious issue. If this light is red, it is usually accompanied by another light, indicating other problems with the vehicle.
fixDescr: If this light comes on, whether it is yellow or red, consult the vehicle’s owners manual or a professional mechanic.

name: Charge Car
description: This light can mean that the vehicle either needs or is currently charging. This light is mostly used in electric and hybrid vehicles as they are the only vehicles that will need charging. This light could be different depending on the type and make of the vehicle. The light could look like a battery, or a charging station.
fixDescr: Once the vehicle is sufficiently charged the light should turn off. The vehicle is safe to drive with the light on, but if the vehicle is not charged soon it is possible that it will stop moving. Just plug the vehicle into a power source.

name: Clogged Air Filter
description: The Clogged Air Filter advisory light is a diesel only warning light. If this light comes on, it might mean that there is a blockage or a problem with the filter that is used to protect the vehicle’s engine. The check engine light may come on as a consequence a blocked air filter.
fixDescr: If this light is on contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible. While the vehicle can be driven with the light on, if the light remains on for long periods of time it can cause damage to the vehicle.

name: Cruise Control
description: As vehicles get smarter, they also get safer. The cruise control is used to maintain a set speed, or change the vehicle’s speed according to traffic conditions. This light will come on when the cruise control is on. If the computer determines that there is an error the light will remain until the problem has been sorted out by a professional mechanic.
fixDescr: Normally this light should turn off when the cruise control is turned off. It could be different depending on the type and make of vehicle, so consult the vehicle’s owners manual, or a professional mechanic if there is a problem.

name: Diesel Particulate Filter Light
description: The Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF) is unique to diesel vehicles. If this light is on, it indicates that there is an issue with the vehicle’s diesel engine filter. This filter is used to capture large particles that come out of the diesel exhaust. This light can also mean that the DPF needs to be cleaned.
fixDescr: There is a process of clearing the particular filter of diesel vehicles. Most of the time it involves trying to activate the vehicle’s regeneration mode. Consult the vehicle’s owners manual for more information, or contact a professional mechanic especially if the light does not go away. Waiting too long to get the light checked can cause problems with he vehicle.

name: Differential Issues
description: The differential is used in most vehicles to help the vehicle make many different movements, including turning. If this light is on it most likely means that the differential is on, whether it be the front, rear or both of the differentials. This light is very similar to the 4 wheel drive light, and the manual should be consulted to determine the correct circumstances to use any of the differentials.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, turn the differential switch off. To figure this out, consult the vehicle’s owners manual, or contact a professional mechanic.

name: Electric Motor Power Reduced Light
description: The Power Limit Indicator Light is a light exclusive to electric vehicles. When this light is on that means that the vehicle has entered low-power mode. The vehicle will enter low powered mode to help the vehicle operate longer on limited battery power, reducing engine power and other features. This light could also be words ‘Reduced Power’
fixDescr: There are many reasons as to why the vehicle may have entered low power mode, so it is important to get it checked out by a professional mechanic if it comes on. While it is fine to drive the vehicle with this light on, it won’t be pleasant since the vehicle will do anything to conserve battery power.

name: Electronic Throttle Light
description: The Electric Throttle Light can come on for several reasons, and most of them are not good. The electric throttle is used with the accelerator, to cause it to accelerate, so if the engine is not getting the signal, it can cause problems to the vehicle. Since it is very complex, it is difficult to determine exactly what the problem is in the electric throttle.
fixDescr: Since there are many reasons this light could come on, it is important to get it checked out by a professional mechanic. It is probably no ideal to drive with this light on.

name: Gas: Fuel Cap
description: The Check Gas Cap Light will light when the gas cap is loose or not screwed well enough. Some vehicles use the check engine light instead of this light to indicate that the gas cap is loose. This can cause a handful of issues, including diminished gas mileage or harmful gases being released into the environment.
fixDescr: If the gas cap looks okay and the light is still on, consult a professional mechanic to determine the issue.

name: Glow Plug Indicator
description: Many diesel powered vehicles need to have the fuel heated before the vehicle is turned on. Some vehicles even require the light to turn off before the vehicle can even be started.
fixDescr: If you are driving a diesel powered vehicle, the you should wait until the Glow Plug Light turns off before you start the vehicle. If this light comes on after the heating, there is a chance that there is a problem with one of the glow plugs, which is common as they wear out over time. If that is the case contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible.

name: Ignition Switch Warning
description: The Ignition Switch Warning light will come on when there is a problem with the ignition switch or the key being used. The problem with the ignition switch is usually mechanical, which prevents the key from turning.
fixDescr: If this light comes on while driving, it could mean that there is a computer glitch, which might result in not being able to turn the car on again when shut off. While it is possible to drive the vehicle with the light on, the vehicle may not be able to start, so a professional mechanic should be contacted as soon as possible.

name: Key Not In Vehicle
description: Many cars no longer need a physical key to turn the vehicle on, but instead use something called a ‘smart key’ which is more convenient. The Key Not in Vehicle Light is more of a reminder to the driver to not drive away without the key.
fixDescr: The light should go away if the correct key is near the vehicle. While the car should be able to be driven, it may not be able to start with the correct key.

name: Lane Departure Warning
description: Safety is one of the main features many car manufactures are taking into account when they build new vehicles. The Lane Departure Warning Light is one of the ways that the manufacturers try to keep drivers safe. When this light comes on, it means that the driver is moving to one side of the road without putting on the turn signal. To alert the driver that they might be doing this is by using a light, sound, vibration, or some combination of the three.
fixDescr: This light should only come on as a reminder that the driver may not be driving safely. If the light is on, try and adjust the position of the vehicle to the center of the lane. Never use this app while driving! If this light remains on contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible.

name: Low Coolant
description: The Low Coolant Light will come on when there is an insignificant amount of coolant in its reservoir. The most common cause of low coolant is a leak somewhere in the system. This light could be replaced by the Engine Temperature Light in some vehicles. For a full understanding of this light consult the vehicle's owners manual
fixDescr: If you feel like you can do it, fill the coolant tank with an appropriate level of coolant. If not go to a mechanic as soon as possible, but DO NOT DRIVE THE VEHICLE if this light comes on. If the light is still on contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible.

name: Low Fuel Level
description: The Low Fuel Level Light will come on when the vehicle is running low on fuel.
fixDescr: Refuel as soon as possible. The drivability of the vehicle shouldn’t be affected when the light is on, but if the vehicle is out of gas it will no be able to function and it is not recommended to drive for long periods of time or distances with low fuel.

name: Message Display
description: The Message Display Light comes on to warn drivers to a message on the vehicle’s display. The message can be something that requires immediate attention, so scroll through the message while not driving. Some messages require you to scroll through the whole thing to be marked as read. It will be red or yellow depending on the severity of the message being read.
fixDescr: The light will remain on as long as the problem that it is describing is rectified, so it may also not be safe to drive until the light goes away. This might be done by contacting a professional mechanic.

name: Overdrive Light
description: The overdrive system is used in the vehicle’s transmission to increase fuel economy and drivability when highway driving. When the Overdrive Light is on, that means that the overdrive system is turned off.  If the Overdrive Light is blinking, it can mean that there is a problem with the vehicle’s transmission.
fixDescr: There should be a switch to turn off the overdrive system, so look through the vehicle’s owners manual to figure out how to do so. You can drive with the Overdrive Light on, but when it is blinking it may be a serious problem so a professional mechanic should be contacted as soon as possible.

name: Press Clutch Pedal
description: The Press Clutch Pedal Light is only on manual transmission vehicles. This light is just a reminder light that the clutch needs to be pressed down before the engine can be started. This image is similar to the press brake pedal light, except that it is just a shoe in a circle, and usually a yellow color.
fixDescr: This light should not come on when the vehicle is being driven, and should turn off when the vehicle is started while the clutch is being pressed down.

name: Rain and Light Sensor
description: Many vehicles are equipped with weather detecting sensors, and the main purpose of the light is to control the automatic headlights. If the Rain and Light Sensor Light is on, that means that either the automatic lights and or windshield wipers have a problem. The light is normally yellow, and can look different depending on the vehicle, so consult the vehicle’s owners manual to see the specifics.
fixDescr: If the light is on, contact a professional mechanic to solve this issue. Once this issue if rectified the light should go away. While the car is drivable with this light on, the cause of the light may make the vehicle unsafe to drive, such as the wipers and headlights not working correctly.

name: Read Manual
description: The Read Manual Light comes on to advise you to reference the owner’s manual for further information. Text comes on along with this light to indicate what to do.
fixDescr: Once the solution the vehicle’s owners manual recommended is implemented the light should go off. If the light remains consult a professional mechanic. Don't read the manual while you are driving.

name: Rear Spoiler Warning
description: A spoiler is used in many high end vehicles to help when keep the vehicle from taking flight when going too fast. Some of the higher end vehicles have adjustable spoilers now, and the Rear Spoiler Warning Light comes on when there is a problem with the spoiler. With the spoiler system not functioning as well as it should, that means that the vehicle may not perform well at a speed greater than the freeway speed.
fixDescr: If the light is on, the computer found a problem with the spoiler system. Once this happens the system will shut down the spoiler system to prevent any damage from happening. While the vehicle is safe to drive with this light on, it may not be safe to drive at high speeds.To solve this problem a professional mechanic will have to diagnose and fix the problem so it should be checked out as soon as possible.

name: Rear:Stop Light Out
description: The Rear or Stop Light Out Light indicates that either one or both tail lights are out.
fixDescr: Once the rear lights are replaced, the warning light should go away. To do this it is recommended to go to a mechanic to replace the lights. It can be illegal to drive with a brake light out, so while it is possible to drive the vehicle with the light on, it may not be recommended.

name: Reduced Power Warning
description: When specific faults occur in the vehicle the Reduced Engine Power Light will come on. The problems could be anything from the engine, transmission, or even the battery. When this light comes on, the vehicle enters ‘Limp Mode’, which means that the vehicle is using limited power to operate.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible. While it is possible to drive with this light on, it will be in low power mode, resulting in diminished performance, so it should only be driven a short distance to the professional mechanic or not at all.

name: Security Alert
description: The Security Alert Light comes on momentarily to indicate that the ignition switch is locked and the key fob for the vehicle is needed to start the vehicle. This light can be similar to the security indicator light. If the light is visible while the vehicle is on, there may be an issue with the security system.
fixDescr: The light should turn off when the correct key is used to turn the vehicle on. If the light is still on, even if the vehicle is turned on, a professional mechanic should be contacted as soon as possible.

name: Service Vehicle Soon
description: The Service Vehicle Soon Light usually comes on with other warning lights. If this light is coupled with another, have the issue that that specific light corresponds to. If no other light comes on, contact a mechanic to run a diagnostic scan of the vehicle.
fixDescr: Once a mechanic diagnoses the problem and corrects the issue, the light should go off. Since this light may come on with other lights it is not recommended to drive with this light on, until it is checked over by a professional mechanic.

name: Shift Up
description: The Shift Up Light is only for manual transmission vehicles. When this light comes on, the car recognizes that you need to shift to a higher gear. This is part of a system to help optimize your travel. This light can have many different looks, depending on what kind of vehicle is being driven, so consult the owner’s manual for further information.
fixDescr: Once the correct gear has been reached, the light should turn off. If the light remains on contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible.

name: Suspension Dampers Issues
description: A part of the vehicle’s suspension are dampers. The Suspension Dampers Issues Light comes on when there may be a problem with the dampers.
fixDescr: If this light comes on, the vehicle should be checked by a mechanic.

name: Traction Control Light
description: The Traction Control Light comes in many different forms, and they all have something to do with the traction control system. Sometimes this light can mean that the traction control is active, while in some cases it can mean that it is faulty. The differences depend on the type of vehicle, so consult the owner’s manual for a more accurate description.
fixDescr: If this light comes on, pull over and consult the vehicle’s owners manual for a description for what to do. Some traction control issues require a mechanic to scan the computer in the vehicle, so contact a professional mechanic for more information.

name: Trailer Tow Hitch Warning
description: The Trailer Tow Hitch Warning Light should only come on in vehicles that have a tow hitch. If this light comes on, that means that there is a problem with the tow hitch, whether it be that the tow hitch is unlocked, or even a problem with the lighting system.
fixDescr: If this light comes on, PULL OVER and make sure everything is okay with the tow hitch. This light should only come on when there is a tow hitch attached to the vehicle.

name: Transmission Issues
description: The Transmission Warning Light comes on when there is an issue with the transmission. Different vehicle brands have different transmission lights. Some look like a gear with an exclamation light, and some look like the undercarriage of a car. Some of the causes of this light could be fluid temperature, fluid levels, or even the pressure inside the transmission. For some vehicles, this light if for the Powertrain or Drivetrain warning light, so refer to the vehicle’s owners manual for more information about the light.
fixDescr: If this light comes on, contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible. It is not recommended to drive with this light on, as prolonged driving can cause a reduced life of the vehicle, as well as entering a limp mode.

name: Washer Fluid Reminder
description: The Washer Fluid Reminder Light comes on when the washer fluid tank is low.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, refill the washer fluid tank with washer fluid.

name: Water in Diesel Filter Warning
description: The Water in Diesel Filter Warning Light is only in diesel vehicles. This light will come on when water is detected in the diesel filter. This can cause severe damage to the vehicle, so it is recommended to have the water drained.
fixDescr: If this light is on, that means that the amount of water that the filter can hold is nearing full. It is then recommended to drain the water as soon as possible. To drain the water, contact a professional mechanic as soon as possible. If the light just came on, it should be fine, but the longer it is left unchecked, the more damage the water can do to the engine.

name: Exhaust Fluid
description: The Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF) Light comes on when the DEF reservoir is low on fluid or contaminated.
fixDescr: To turn the light off, fill the reservoir to the appropriate level. It is recommended not to drive while ignoring the DEF light, as while it is safe to drive, the DEF fluid helps the vehicle run more efficiently.

name: Electric Park Brake
description: The Electric Park Brake Light will come on when there is an issue with the parking brake. When this light is on the parking brake may become unable to operate properly. For more information, consult with the vehicle’s owners manual.
fixDescr: If this light comes on it is recommended to contact a mechanic. As it is a problem with the brakes, and since it might not function properly when you need them, the vehicle should probably not be driven until it is checked by a professional mechanic.

name: Adaptive Front Lighting System Warning
description: Depending on the make of the vehicle and the color of the light, this could mean a couple things. Green: Directional Headlights. Indicates that the vehicles automatic directional headlights are operational. Yellow: Adaptive Warning Light: Some Vehicles have lights that turn on automatically and adjust brightness depending on how dark and light it is. If the light is Yellow, that means that there is a malfunction with the sensor for that light.
fixDescr: If the light is yellow, a professional mechanic should be contacted to fix the problem. The headlights should still be able to function even thought the Adaptive Lighting System is not.

name: Adaptive Light System
description: The Adaptive Light warning light comes on when there is a problem with the adaptive lighting system. The adaptive lighting system helps move the headlights when turning for safer nighttime travel. Depending on the make of the vehicle, the type of adaptive lights could be different, so refer to the vehicle’s owners manual for more information on the vehicle’s lighting system. The cause of the warning light could be anything from a malfunction in the system to dirt and debris on the sensors.
fixDescr: Since it is difficult to determine the exact cause for the warning to come on, a professional mechanic will have to be contacted to determine the exact cause, and to turn the light off. While the adaptive lighting system is useful to have, and makes driving easier, it is not needed to drive at night. As long as the headlights are still working, driving should not be a problem.

name: Convertible Roof Warning Light
description: The Convertible Roof Warning Light can come on for a few reasons, and depending on the type and make of the vehicle, they may do different things. If the light is on it can mean that the vehicle’s convertible roof is opening or closing. If the light is flashing, it could mean there is a problem with the convertible roof, and may need repairing. If the light remains on when the roof is not opening or closing, then there might be a fault or obstruction with the convertible roof.
fixDescr: The light should turn off when the action the convertible roof is suppose to do is completed. If there is a problem with the convertible roof, a professional mechanic should be contacted, so repairs can be made.

name: Light Out: On
description: This image can mean different things depending on which vehicle it is in.  In some vehicles this light is the Light Out warning light, which means that a light either inside or outside of the vehicle has been burned out, and will need replacing. However, in some vehicles, this light can mean the opposite, that a light is on at the time. Usually the light on light doesn’t have the ‘!’ inside of it. To figure out what the light corresponds too, refer to the vehicle’s owners manual.
fixDescr: Depending on which message this light refers to, the process to turn the light off is different. In some cases it involves either turning the light it corresponds to off, or replacing the light that is out. Refer to the owners manual for more information about this light. It is not recommended to drive at night with a light not working.

name: Child Safety Lock
description: Many cars are getting electronic controlled child locks. These make it so that anyone in the back seats can’t open the door from the inside. The light means that the electric child lock is enabled. This light could look different depending on the type and make of the vehicle. To check this light, consult the vehicle's owners manual.
fixDescr: This light is generally a reminder that the child safety light is engaged, so to turn the light off turn the child safety lock off.

name: Daytime Running Lamp Light
description: The Daytime Running Lights (DRL) are an automatic system that turn on lights when the vehicle is on and moving. When this light is on, it means that the DRL is activated. When the DRL is activated, it makes the vehicle more visible during the daytime, and alerts other drivers when/if they are in their blind spot.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, turn the switch for the Daytime Running Light off. For more information, consult the vehicle’s owners manual.

name: Fog Lights On
description: The Fog Light is on when the driver turns the fog lights on, and in some vehicles the type of fog light is determined by the direction they are facing. If the image is facing the right it is the front fog lights. If it is facing the left, it is the rear fog lights. It is recommended to not drive in the fog with out the fog lights.
fixDescr: To turn the fog light off, turn the switch for the fog light off.

name: Headlight Range Control
description: The Headlight Range Control is a function of the headlights to change the angle of the headlights according to the position of the vehicle. These lights use sensors at the front of the car to monitor the angle of the vehicle and help it adjust the headlights accordingly, so this warning light comes on when there is an issue with the system.
fixDescr: To fix the headlight range control, a professional mechanic may need to be contacted. Even with the headlight range control not working properly, as long as the headlights work the vehicle should be safe to drive.

name: High Beam Indicator
description: The High Beam will turn on when you switch the high beam headlamps on. It is good practice to not have the high beams on when a vehicle is oncoming. Some newer vehicles have auto high beams, that turn on automatically.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, turn the high beam switch off.

name: Hill Descent Control
description: As time goes on, the smarter and safer a car gets. The Hill Descent Control Light comes on when the vehicles system activates hill descent mode, which helps you maintain a specific speed when driving down hill. Refer to the vehicle’s owners manual for more specific information about how this system affects your vehicle. Some vehicles also turn the hill descent control on automatically, while others have to be toggled on.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, if there is a toggle for the hill decent control, press the toggle.

name: Hood Open
description: The Hood Open Light comes on when the latch disengages, allowing the hood to be lifted with ease.
fixDescr: If the light turns on when driving, check the hood immediately, as the hood could obstruct vision if up. You can move the vehicle with the light on, but it is not recommended to do so.

name: Hybrid Ready Indicator
description: One of the differences between normal and hybrid vehicles is that hybrid vehicle’s engines have little to no sound. The Hybrid Ready Light comes on as a replacement for the loud sound that regular vehicles make when they start to indicate that it is ready to go. This light could be different depending on the vehicle. It could be the word ‘READY’ or an image of a car with a double pointed arrow below it.
fixDescr: This light should not be turned off, so if the vehicle is on and the Hybrid Ready Light is not, there could be a problem with the system.

name: Icy Road Warning Light
description: The Icy Road Warning Light will turn on when the outside temperature is detected to be at or below the freezing level. At that temperature, it could impact the conditions of the roadways. This light is used as an indicator for possibly hazardous driving conditions.
fixDescr: The light should only turn on when the sensors detect that the outside temperature is at the point that it is freezing. Once the outside temperature warms up, it should turn off.

name: Economy Mode
description: The Economy Light will turn on when the vehicle is in its most economically responsible setting.  When the light is on it will help the vehicle’s fuel economy as well as reduce emissions. The light will turn off when the vehicle drives past the manufacture’s set economy standard. There are a couple different Economy lights, so refer to the vehicle’s owners manual for more information about this light.
fixDescr: It is recommended to drive while the Economy Light is on, as it will help reduce fuel consumption, as well as other added benefits.

name: Electric Vehicle Mode Activated
description: The Electric Vehicle (EV) Mode Light will come on when the owner of the vehicle has enabled EV mode. In this mode, the electric motor will be the only motor used for a limited time. This light is only found in hybrid vehicles. In some vehicles this light comes on with another light, known as the EV Drive Mode Light, both indicating that the vehicle is running using only the electric motor.
fixDescr: To turn this light off, press the switch for the EV mode off.

name: Low Beam Indicator Light
description: The Low Beam Indicator Light, or the Dipped Headlight light is a light that turns on when the low beam lights are on. It is recommended to check the Highway Code to see what conditions are ideal to use the low beams/dipped headlights.
fixDescr: Once the low beam headlights are turned off, the light should turn off.

name: Park Assist Light
description: The Park Assist Light comes on to tell the driver that the parking assist system is engaged. These systems utilize sensors on the front and back of the vehicle to detect how close another vehicle is to other objects. It is recommended to not rely solely on the parking assist feature when trying to park. In some vehicles if the Park Assist Light is yellow, flashing or both, it could mean that there is an issue with the sensors.
fixDescr: Once the park assist feature is no longer active, the light should turn off. One of the common causes for the Park Assist light to be flashing is that there could be dirt blocking the sensors. If the vehicle is washed and the light is still flashing, contact a professional mechanic.

name: Predictive Efficiency Assist Light
description: The Predictive Efficiency Assist Light comes on when the car is able to instinctively recognize when in your travels it is best to slow down or accelerate.
fixDescr: Once the vehicle senses that the you no longer need to accelerate or slow down, the light should turn off.

name: Press Brake Pedal
description: The Press Brake Pedal Light is also known as the automatic shift lock, or engine start indicator warning light. When this light is on that means that you need to either engage the brake to either start the vehicle or get out of neutral gear.
fixDescr: Once the vehicle is started, the light should turn off. The light should not be on when the vehicle is driving, so if it is, contact a professional mechanic.

name: Rear Window Defrost
description: The Rear Window Defrost Light comes on when the rear windshield heater is on.
fixDescr: To turn off this light, turn the rear windshield heater off.

name: Side Light Indicator
description: The Side Light Indicator comes on when the side lights are turned on.
fixDescr: To turn the light off, turn the light switch for the side lights to off, or a different light setting.

name: Windshield Defrost
description: The Windshield Defrost Light comes on when the windshield defrost is turned on.
fixDescr: Once the windshield defrost is turned off, the light should turn off as well.

name: Winter Mode
description: The Winter Mode Light comes on when the winter mode button is pressed. When in winter mode the vehicle will start in a higher gear, to help in icy and snowy conditions. This light may be in the image of a snowflake or a ‘W’. Refer to the vehicle’s owners manual for more information.
fixDescr: Once the winter mode is turned off, the light should go away.
